description: AGSC-11-20 as amended for 1.1: a restricted node does not serve /chunks.jsonl unauthenticated, so the chunks surface it declares carries agsc-access credential, while llms-txt, which it does serve, keeps none (AGSC-11-16). Derivation: the node is restricted and emits /llms.txt and /chunks.jsonl; the declaration links are the two surface links of AGSC-11-16 with the class each takes. A public node's chunks link keeps none (bnd-0037).
